models.MemberProfile: The authenticated member's own profile data including contact information, an optional second contact on the membership, mailing address, membership details, volunteer roles with certification status, and payment status.
models.VolunteerGroup: A group of volunteers sharing the same role, with their names, certification statuses, and the group lead's contact information.
models.Message: A message sent from the member to a membership admin or volunteer role lead, displayed in the member's Messages inbox.
models.PaymentRecord: A record of a membership payment or renewal, including amount, method (card/paypal/venmo/zelle), date, and confirmation status.
models.ProcessingFeeConfig: Percentage and fixed rates used to compute the exact fee a member can opt to cover during renewal so the Society nets the full amount.
models.ZelleConfig: Zelle recipient details shown when the member chooses the fee-free Zelle method during renewal; Zelle renewals are reconciled manually by an admin.

relationships: MemberProfile has one MembershipLevel and zero or many VolunteerRoles
VolunteerGroups are derived from the member's active VolunteerRoles — one group per role
Messages are sent by the member to admin or role lead recipients
PaymentRecords are associated with the MemberProfile
The renewal flow uses ProcessingFeeConfig for the card/PayPal/Venmo fee checkbox and ZelleConfig for the fee-free Zelle option
